facts.text: NavUserPassword is generally available as an authentication method
NavUserPassword is authentication handled by server using usernames and passwords configured within Business Central only
Security certificates are required to secure client connections over wide area networks for NavUserPassword
Production environments require certificate from certification authority; test environments can use self-signed certificates
Set up your user account with password by opening Users page, selecting your account, and entering password under Business Central Password Authentication
Configure server by setting ClientServicesCredentialType to NavUserPassword using Set-NAVServerConfiguration cmdlet or Administration Tool, then restart server instance
Configure web server by opening navsettings.json and setting ClientServicesCredentialType key value to NavUserPassword, then save file
Web service accounts can optionally be set up using Access Key for SOAP and OData Web Service Authentication
